name: NeuroAds
task: Website or Shopify chat & FAQ deflection
summary: AI chat widget for Shopify trained on your catalogue, orders and policy pages that replies in the shopper's own language, with rich product cards, discount codes, order tracking and add-to-cart inside the chat. Launched June 2026 with six App Store reviews.
best_for: small and mid-size Shopify stores that want a multilingual, catalogue-aware chat widget with product cards, order tracking and add-to-cart, and want to judge it on the genuinely usable free tier of 200 conversations a month
skip_if: you need a support desk with a track record, you cannot budget against a 'conversation' nobody has defined, or routing customer names, phone numbers and addresses through a ten-week-old vendor is not a trade you want to make
honest_knock:
The app is young. It launched on 5 June 2026 and, as of 19 August 2026, had six reviews — all five stars, all posted between 7 and 15 August, by merchants who had had it installed for five, eleven and thirteen days. Nothing about that is suspicious on its face; new apps have new reviews. But six enthusiastic first impressions from people two weeks in tell you the setup is smooth and tell you nothing about what happens when the bot gets a refund question wrong in month four. By 9 October 2026 there were twelve, still all five stars. On the same page, Shopify Inbox is free with 5,488 reviews.

In August the listing contradicted itself on the trial: the summary promised a 30-day trial while the pricing table showed seven days. By 9 October 2026 the summary says only 'Free trial available' and all three paid plans show a 7-day free trial, so plan on seven days and check it in the charge screen.

And look at what it asks for. This app requests names, email addresses, phone numbers and physical addresses of your customers, plus geolocation and IP, sixty days of order history, your discount codes and your store pages. That is a defensible list for a bot that tracks orders and offers codes, and it is also a lot of customer data to route through an app launched in June 2026 on the strength of a dozen reviews. The privacy policy (last updated 10 July 2026) answers part of it: hosting and storage on Amazon Web Services in the US region, order data fetched live rather than stored, and chat transcripts deleted 90 days after a conversation ends. Check that against your own obligations before you switch it on for a store with EU shoppers.

pricing.entry_price_terms: Starter · per month for 800 conversations, live human takeover and discount codes in chat, billed in USD every 30 days with a 7-day free trial
pricing.notes: (read 2026-08-19 and re-verified unchanged 2026-10-09 on apps.shopify.com/neuroads-chatbot) Four tiers, priced by conversations per month. Free: 200 conversations, AI answers about products, collections and orders, rich product cards with add-to-cart, order status and tracking in chat, replies in the shopper's language. Starter $19 a month: 800 conversations, plus live human takeover and discount codes offered in chat, 7-day free trial. Growth $49 a month or $468 a year (save 20%): 3,000 conversations, plus a revenue and ROAS dashboard, A/B testing on the chat greeting, answer insights and Klaviyo, 7-day free trial. Unlimited $119 a month or $1,142 a year (save 20%): unlimited conversations, WhatsApp and Klaviyo, advanced reporting with CSV export, chat-only discount codes, removal of the 'Powered by NeuroAds' label, a year of conversation history and dedicated onboarding, 7-day free trial. All charges are billed in USD and recur every 30 days. Two things the pricing table does not settle. What counts as one conversation — a shopper session, a thread, a single message — is defined nowhere, and it is the only unit the whole ladder is built on. On 19 August 2026 the listing summary also advertised a 30-day trial against the table's seven days; on 9 October 2026 the summary says only 'Free trial available' and every paid plan shows a 7-day free trial. Developer NEUROAD VENTURES LLC of Newport Beach, California; the app launched 5 June 2026 and had six App Store reviews on 19 August 2026 and twelve, all five stars, on 9 October 2026.
